# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** open a thread in [Discussions](https://github.com/JAbarca74/PassRipple/discussions), in English or Spanish.
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/JAbarca74/PassRipple/issues/new/choose) with the bug report template.
- **Security problems:** never in public. Follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).

PassRipple is pre-alpha and maintained by a small team, so answers may take a few days.
